services.name: Downtown Chicago Tour
services.desc: The best helicopter tours in Chicago are with Heli Chicago! Duration 45 minutes About Make memories that will last a lifetime! Hop in as we begin our tour from Schaumburg Regional Airport and head East to the Chicago Skyline. We'll fly past the United Center, Soldier field, Willis Tower (formerly the Sears Tower), the John Hancock Building, and Wrigley Field... Sorry Sox fans. Next we'll turn back towards the South and pass along the backside of all those buildings. At this point you may be noticing all the Chicago traffic and be glad you decided to skip that by flying high above it! Landmarks You'll See (Subject to change depending on weather conditions) United Center Soldier Field Sears
